description: (needs account token) Link an HTTPS backend you host on AWS, Google Cloud, DigitalOcean or your own server behind a DropTheHassle name. The URL must be an HTTPS origin (no path, port 443, a hostname with an IPv4 address); paths pass through unchanged. With uploaded files the path rules (default /api/*) reverse-proxy to the backend and the rest stays static; without uploaded files the WHOLE site serves from the backend. It needs the account token of the human: WITHOUT site it creates a fresh FREE site in that account first, so a backend-only project goes live on its own link in one call; with site, the site must be claimed in that account (a site token or an unclaimed site gets 403 "Claim this site first to connect a backend."). Perfect for a deploy script: call this with the new URL after every backend deploy. Pass url="" (with site) to unlink. Changing an existing site changes what its visitors get: pass confirm=true only after the human said yes (a deploy script the human set up counts). A new site needs no confirm. No money. Never buy anything without asking me. Never buy a domain, email or subscription for me without asking first. When something costs money, give me the payment link and let me pay.

confirm.description: Needed with site: true ONLY after the human said yes to this change.

paths.description: Optional path rules for split mode, e.g. ["/api/*", "/webhooks/*"]. Default ["/api/*"].

site.description: Optional: the address of an existing site to link (from list_sites). Omit to create a new free site served fully from the backend.

slug.description: Optional address label for a NEW site, e.g. "myapp" -> myapp.dropthehassle.app. Errors when taken.

url.description: The HTTPS origin of the backend, e.g. "https://api.example.com". Empty string (with site) unlinks.

name: set_backend
